affected_boundaries: per-file parse cache to published generation

observed_behavior: Traceability index publication fails with duplicate entity_v1 primary key for a plan referenced by its plan document and sprint.
expected_behavior: One stable entity and every distinct relationship publish successfully.
causal_mechanism: Per-file maps deduplicate locally, but flattening multiple payloads repeats a global stable entity ID.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Flatten independently normalized records into a globally unique database table.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Local uniqueness does not establish uniqueness across file boundaries.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Each generation contains one entity per stable identity and one edge per source/target/role.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Normalize the corpus by entity identity and relationship tuple before inserts.

applicability_conditions: Multiple configured files annotate one stable entity.
known_non_matches: Unrelated requirements have different stable identities.
confirmation_evidence: Pure parse inspection identified the duplicated plan identity.
Original live PostgreSQL command failed; corrected publication succeeded.
regression_proofs: tests/traceability-projection.test.ts: cross-file plan references publish one entity and every distinct relationship
tests/project-index.test.js: publishes repeated cross-file plan references once without losing edges
